messages:
maya: Quick note 1 — support tickets show users confused by mixed timeout names (`timeout_ms`, `timeout_seconds`, `deadlineMs`) in examples. I think we should pick one for copy/paste snippets.

trent: Strong +1 for `timeout_ms` in JS/Python/HTTP examples. Unit explicitness avoids ambiguity.

zoe: For Go keep `context.WithTimeout` but add a one-line mapping comment like `// maps to timeout_ms=3000`.

sam: Also add a short errref blurb: client-side timeout != server 429 Retry-After. Retry-After is a server-suggested retry window (seconds), not a client abort.

maya: Plan: I'll run a quick grep for `deadline` and open a tiny PR to replace examples. We'll leave Go bits idiomatic and add the mapping comment.

trent: Can we also ensure streaming examples mention cancel semantics? Users should know cancelling a stream may not stop server-side generation immediately.

zoe: I'll draft a 2-sentence streaming caveat to paste in errref and the streaming page.

maya: Action items: maya open PR wip, trent run snippet-lint after, zoe add streaming note, sam sanity-check wording. Target merge early next week.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Created checklist: [ ] replace mixed params with timeout_ms in quickstarts, [ ] add Go mapping comment, [ ] streaming caveat, [ ] update errref conversion table, [ ] snippet-lint + link-check.
